name: M7.OrbitFibers.fiber_equiv
statement: ∀ (G : Type) [Group G] [Fintype G] (X : Type) [MulAction G X] (c : X), ∀ g₀ : G, Nonempty ({h : G // h • c = c} ≃ {g : G // g • c = g₀ • c})
queries: MulAction orbit stabilizer equivalence fiber cardinality
guidance: Construct the actual equivalence by h↦g0*h and g↦g0⁻¹*g. Use mul_smul and inverse identities, Subtype.ext for inverse laws. This includes nonfaithful actions; no orbit cardinality is assumed. Return tactic lines only without leading by.
